evidence.summary: Anthropic confirms the June suspension and its June 30 announcement says Fable 5 would return July 1. Original June 13 event reporting must not imply a permanent disappearance. Only the identified source scope was checked; other historical claims remain outside this review.
evidence.limits: Company announcements do not establish independent technical verification. This limited check does not replicate experiments, verify every historical specification or establish present-day availability; it is not a full fact-check.

corrections.note: Added the June 30 Anthropic announcement describing a July 1 return. The June suspension account remains historical; the follow-up does not declare that reporting false or independently establish current access or government findings.
